facts.title: energy isolation failure on SG-7000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control MUSTER_AND_ACCOUNTING: the alarm, muster and accounting for people was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on SG-7000 and TX-7001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically alarming, mustering and accounting for people. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 March 2021 an incident occurred on SG-7000 and TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
